d: The face is obscured by a white and purple hood and veil, revealing only a golden-skinned, mature visage with a calm, focused expression. The build is slender and ethereal, draped in voluminous white and royal purple robes with gold filigree and a flowing purple cape. Accessories include a tall, ornate golden staff topped with a purple gem, floating purple energy spheres, and gold armor plates on the shoulders and waist. BODY COLOR: Golden-tan LEGS: Plantigrade, clad in purple fabric and boots.
